mandatory_outputs: finite provider failure code for every rejected call
finite schema/business rule codes for every invalid output
provider-reported token counts and estimated cost for invalid as well as valid outputs
allocation_policy: candidate_allocation remains 0 regardless of the diagnostic outcome; no automatic allocation change is authorized
post_v2_rule: If v2 exposes an implementation or request-contract defect, repair it offline before another live call. If it yields a distinguishing but underpowered signal, preregister a separate expansion within the remaining cumulative budget. If it yields no distinguishing signal, do not expand blindly.
key_handling: Read provider keys from process environment only; never write values to repository, logs or evidence.
